answer: Re-attestations are stored in zephyr and juniper lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the garden graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 651 identities would post 3835 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
